full_judgment: 4. The suit was contested by the defendant Nos. 1-3 denying the material averments made in the plaint and stating, inter alia, that the land of the khatian No.4 belonged to Dharani Dhar Malo and that plaintiff is the daughter of Dharani Dhar's second wife, that while plaintiff was in possession of Dharani Dhar's property she sold some property to Abul Hossain, Rustom Ali and Manu Chowdhury, that the rest of the land has been recorded in the name of Dharani Dhar Malo, that rent having not been paid certificate case was started and in the certificate case land in suit was put to auction and the defendants have purchased the land in suit, that notice of the certificate case as well as the notice of the auction proceeding was duly served and the auction was held within the knowledge of the plaintiff, that the defendants got possession within the knowledge of the plaintiff, that defendants have erected hut in some portion of the land and that rest of the land was possessed by them upon cultivating the same, that defendants upon mutation of their names paying rent, that plaintiff filed Miscellaneous case before the certificate officer for setting aside of the auction sale but the same was dismissed.
